chain_focus: AI compute and connectivity in and through space: orbital data centers (SpaceX Starmind, Google Project Suncatcher, Starcloud, Axiom Space, Sophia Space, Cowboy Space) built on space-grade AI compute (NVIDIA Space-1 Vera Rubin / IGX Thor / Jetson Orin, AMD XQR Versal) and radiation-hardened semiconductors, with AWS as the cloud for satellite data; the LEO connectivity and backhaul they depend on (Starlink, Amazon Leo, AST SpaceMobile, Kepler optical relay) with optical inter-satellite links, satellite RF / timing / connectivity components, RF foundries, RF test, PCBs and compound-semiconductor materials; satellite manufacturing and launch (Falcon 9 / Starship, New Glenn, Vulcan, Ariane 6, Electron / Neutron) with their booster, engine, propulsion-gas and cryogenic suppliers; and space solar power.
